# Local Third-Party Sources

This directory is reserved for local source trees required by the native Doom bridge.

The expected layout is:

```text
third_party/doomgeneric/
  doomgeneric/
    doomgeneric.c
    doomgeneric.h
    ...
```

The `third_party/doomgeneric/` tree is intentionally ignored by git. Add it locally only when you are allowed to use that source under its own license terms.
